title: cordylanthus maritimus subsp. canescens
intro: Cordylanthus maritimus subsp. canescens, commonly known as the Sand Verbena, is a plant species that belongs to the Plantaginaceae family. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sand Verbena include its antimicrobial and antiviral properties, which can aid in the treatment of infections and viral diseases. The bioactive constituents of Sand Verbena include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
